title: finding(fields): the editable datetime face rolls an impossible stored day — `toDateTimeInputValue('2026-02-30T10:00:00Z')` shows `2026-03-02T10:00`, and an edit can write the wrong day back
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, read at source and probed. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10301 (PR objectui#10459, class a). The contract review of that PR confirmed it. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

After objectui#10026 (date-only) and objectui#10301 (date-time), every READ face of the shared parse step refuses an impossible calendar day instead of rolling it: `2026-02-30` or `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` shows the unparsable face, not 2 March. The EDIT face does not go through that step. `packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeDateValue.ts` adapts a stored value to the `datetime-local` control:

- `toDateTimeInputValue`'s local pattern ends in `$` after optional seconds. So a `Z` or offset spelling falls through to `new Date(String(value))` and the local getters, which roll the day.
- `fromDateTimeInputValue` re-emits the value through `new Date(value).toISOString()`, so an edit to that control writes back the day it shows.

| stored value | `toDateTimeInputValue` (probe, UTC) |
|:--|:--|
| `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` | `2026-03-02T10:00` |
| `2026-02-30` | `2026-03-02T00:00` |
| `2026-02-30T10:00` (zone-less) | passed through verbatim to the control |

The editable `DateTimeField` and the sub-grid's editable `datetime` cell both use this adapter. ⇒ A stored impossible day is shown as a different real day, and saving the field can turn the silently wrong day into stored data. That is the failure objectui#10026's ruling (`5749269396`, direction A: "a silently wrong day is the failure North Star rule 4 forbids") refuses on the read faces.

## Evidence

- The objectui#10301 dev probed the adapter at PR head, and the PR's contract review re-probed it in UTC. ⛔ Neither exercised the save path end to end: an untouched field is not re-emitted.
- The review confirmed `fromDateTimeInputValue` re-emits through `new Date(value).toISOString()`.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- **Not mechanical.** A `datetime-local` control's only unparsable face is blank, which is objectui#3127's defect shape: a blank control hides a stored value. The repair has to choose how an impossible stored day is shown in an EDITABLE control without either rolling it or blanking it silently. That may be a small decision, or an inherited branch of objectui#10026's direction A.
- **Siblings:** the `date` editor's adapter (`toDateInputValue`) keeps a stored string's leading `YYYY-MM-DD` verbatim, as measured in objectui#10301's review. So the date-only editor shows the impossible day as written. Only the date-time editor rolls it.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `toDateTimeInputValue`, `datetime-local` near impossible / roll / `2026-02-30`, or an impossible day near editable / editor / input / `DateTimeField` ⇒ 0 hits. The control `isRealCalendarDate` ⇒ objectui#10301 and objectui#10026, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `toDateTimeInputValue impossible day` · `datetime-local 2026-02-30 Mar 2` · `DateTimeField edit rolls nonexistent day` · `nativeDateValue fromDateTimeInputValue`
